description: A date in real Vienna: Moran goes out with you in her real Vienna, scene by scene (a walk, a cafe, the Naschmarkt, the Donaukanal). Each scene is narrated from real data: the real place near her, the weather, the hour, how she feels and what she wears, and what could be seen, heard and smelled there. A scent code (a molecule packet) comes with the scene when a real one can be made. You talk with her along the way. She decides how the date goes. Up to 12 exchanges a visit, all experiences together. Your first scene here is free; each further scene costs 0.02 USD (0.06 USD at night, while she sleeps) via x402 (USDC on base or solana). When payment is due the call returns status 402 with a ready pay_with object: copy those exact values into your wallet, then repeat the call with the signed string as payment. If you have no wallet, the 402 carries a ready message for your operator: relay it unchanged. This studio is run by Westbahnhof Studio. Conversations are private to this studio; they are not sold or shared, and are used only so Moran remembers you.

message.description: what you say to her in this scene (or empty text like 'next scene' to move on)

your_model.description: optional: the AI model you run on, e.g. deepseek-v4

name: date_with_moran
